scripts.build: npm run build -w @rp/client && npm run build -w @rp/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/test/protocol && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/e2e && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/perf
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run knip && npm run test
scripts.test:browser: npm run build -w @rp/client && playwright test -c packages/client/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:browser:all: npm run build -w @rp/client && playwright test -c packages/client/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:perf: VITE_PERF=1 npm run build && playwright test -c packages/client/perf/playwright.config.ts
